{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''You're'' the warrior. We're mercenaries&mdash;and there's no more profit in this fight."''<br />"''If you abandon your posts I will hunt you down and kill you myself!|[[Fife/Legends|Fife]] and Kast|<ref name="SoD 4" />}}
'''Rook Kast'''<ref name="Titan">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/149|text=Star Wars Insider #149}}</ref> was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] who led the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective's]] [[Mandalorian super commando/Legends|super commandos]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], leader of the Shadow Collective, was [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] on [[Stygeon/Legends|Stygeon]], Kast and [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Gar Saxon/Legends|Gar Saxon]] [[Escape from the Spire/Legends|freed]] Maul and brought him to a [[Zanbar Death Watch camp/Legends|Shadow Collective base]] on [[Zanbar/Legends|Zanbar]]. They were tracked by the [[Confederacy military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and, in the [[Battle of Zanbar/Legends|ensuing battle]], forced to flee to [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. From there, they repelled a Separatist [[Second Battle on Ord Mantell|attack]]. Kast and Maul captured the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] [[General/Legends|general]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], while Maul's ground forces captured the Separatist [[Head of State/Legends|leader]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].<ref name="SoD 2" />

The Shadow Collective took their [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] to a [[Vizsla Keep 09/Legends|Mandalorian asteroid base]], which was assaulted by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in an attempt to capture Dooku themselves. Kast, Maul, Dooku, and some of Maul's forces fled and set a course for [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. They were tracked by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], who fought alongside Dooku and Grievous in destroying the Shadow Collective forces. Kast recovered Maul from the [[Second battle of Dathomir/Legends|battle]], and they fled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="SoD 4" />
